name: neracu/rebrief
summary: Local CLI that scans a codebase and writes a structured markdown handoff report.
use_cases: scan a local repo or remote Git URL
detect tech stack and dependencies across ecosystems
map secrets, technical debt and missing tests
features: analyze codebase and generate Markdown summary
surface git history timeline and hotspots
map hardcoded secrets and technical debt risks

usage_guide.open_hint: Run `rebrief scan <repo> -o <file>` to scan a repository and write a Markdown report.

features.feature: analyze codebase and generate Markdown summary
features.title: Scan a codebase and write a Markdown report
steps: Run `rebrief scan <repo> -o <file> --no-blame --skip-vulnerability-check` to scan the repository and save the report.
Open the report file. It starts with a "REBRIEF REPORT" heading for your repository.

features.title: Detect the tech stack from manifest files
steps: Run `rebrief scan <repo> -f json -o <file> --no-blame --skip-vulnerability-check` to get a JSON report.
Look at the `tech_stack` section for languages, frameworks, manifests and dependencies.

features.feature: surface git history timeline and hotspots
features.title: Show the Git history timeline and hotspots
steps: Run `rebrief scan <repo> -f json -o <file> --no-blame --skip-vulnerability-check` to get a JSON report.
Look at the `timeline` section for the commit history.

features.feature: map hardcoded secrets and technical debt risks
features.title: Find hardcoded secrets and technical debt
steps: Run `rebrief scan <repo> -f json -o <file> --no-blame --skip-vulnerability-check` to get a JSON report.
Look at the `risk_map` section for secrets and technical debt findings.

steps.purpose: install rebrief via uv tool install
install rebrief via uv tool install

setup.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/testrepo && cd /tmp/testrepo && git init -q && git config user.email "test@example.com" && git config user.name "Tester"
cat > package.json <<'EOF'
{"name":"testapp","version":"1.0.0","dependencies":{"react":"18.0.0","express":"4.18.0"}}
EOF
cat > requirements.txt <<'EOF'
flask==3.0.0
fastapi==0.110.0
EOF
cat > go.mod <<'EOF'
module example.com/app
go 1.21
require github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1
EOF
mkdir -p src
cat > src/app.py <<'EOF'
# TODO: refactor this module
API_KEY = "sk_test_1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef"
def hello():
    # FIXME: handle errors
    pass
EOF
echo "# Test Repo" > README.md
git add . && git commit -qm "Initial commit: add stack manifests"
echo "minor change" >> README.md && git commit -am "fix typo" -q
echo "feature code" > src/feature.py && git add . && git commit -qm "feat: add feature module with important logic"
echo "done" && ls -R /tmp/testrepo

smoke_tests.command: rebrief scan /tmp/testrepo -f json -o /tmp/REBRIEF.json --no-blame --skip-vulnerability-check 2>&1 && echo "JSON_OK" && cat /tmp/REBRIEF.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('/tmp/REBRIEF.json')); print('tech_stack:', d.get('tech_stack')); print('timeline len:', len(d.get('timeline',[]))); print('risk_map:', d.get('risk_map'))"

what_it_does.quote: An AI-ready CLI that analyzes your codebase and generates a clean Markdown summary of your repository.

who_it_is_for.quote: You join a new project - after an outsourcing handoff, a freelancer exit, or years of legacy development.

config_and_keys.quote: No cloud upload, no API keys.

troubleshooting_uninstall.quote: Error: Unable to access remote repository. Check the URL or your Git authentication credentials.

evidence.quote: A local CLI that scans any codebase and produces a structured `REBRIEF.md` report
A local CLI that scans any codebase and produces a structured `REBRIEF.md` report
A local CLI that scans any codebase and produces a structured `REBRIEF.md` report in ~30 seconds - stack, context, history, risks, and a where-to-start checklist.
Point it at any local repo or a remote Git URL.
Recursive scan for ecosystem manifests across JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, PHP, and Ruby
Static analysis for hardcoded secrets, unresolved technical debt (TODO/FIXME), missing test directories
No cloud upload, no API keys.
analyzes your codebase and generates a clean Markdown summary of your repository.
Recursive scan for ecosystem manifests across JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, PHP, and Ruby
Filters low-value commits (wip, fix typo, minor updates) to surface a cleaner timeline of meaningful changes and 30-day change-density hotspots.
Static analysis for hardcoded secrets, unresolved technical debt (TODO/FIXME), missing test directories, and dependency conflicts.
